## About
EuroCraft Exteriors started as a remodeling company. Founder Paul Kraft came from manufacturing management and sales support. When he bought his first house and needed a new roof, he found that most construction companies gave fairly poor service.
He started EuroCraft to do better: help customers understand the process, give them clear information, and take the time to address what they need. Today the team works on metal roofing, shingle roofing, siding and windows for homeowners and businesses throughout Austin.
We're rated 5 from 42 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to come take a look at your place.

## Services
- Metal roofing: Standing seam metal roofs. We install double locked 24 gauge standing seam, which holds up better than snap lock and R-panel metal roofing.
- Shingle roofing: A selection of quality shingles, from architectural to wind resistant and hail resistant options.
- Windows: Premium windows in single hung, sliding, casement and awning styles, plus custom shapes.
- Siding: James Hardie fiber cement siding, installed to the manufacturer's guidelines and painted once it's up. Color Plus with baked on paint is also available.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free inspections?
A: Yes. Every project begins with a free inspection. We visit your property, listen to your concerns and your design preferences, then give you an estimate.

Q: Is financing available?
A: Yes. Along with your estimate, we can offer financing options if you need them.

Q: Do you work on commercial properties?
A: Yes. We work with both homeowners and businesses throughout Austin.
